title: Synthetic Anti-Alignment-Faking Training Data: Can Self-Generated Counterexamples Reduce Faking?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If synthetic anti-faking data works, it is a scalable intervention. But the hypothesis that explicit honest-behavior examples reduce faking is speculative and may not hold.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires generating a synthetic dataset of honest-under-monitoring examples, fine-tuning on it, then evaluating faking compliance gaps. Dataset design is non-trivial and fine-tuning adds compute burden.
